decisions.basis: Imported profile labels, pinned versions and proof files establish neither runtime availability nor a working current-definition provider.
decisions.choice: Bind exact Python runtime and implemented modules; PATH/module misses state only their checked discovery scope.

decisions.basis: Do not select a provider from a requested marketing label.
decisions.choice: Derive supported logic from the checked interpretation and actual query AST before testing route availability.

decisions.basis: A05 fixes universal-property minimum to mechanized-theorem; finite support cannot weaken it.
decisions.choice: Keep model-local evaluation, model witnesses, finite exhaustion, solver evidence and mechanized theorems separate proposition-dependent strengths.

decisions.basis: P01 is capability assessment and sealed policy; implementation belongs to later units.
decisions.choice: Plan generic finite/SMT/kernel adapters, with exact declarative budgets, but do not install or execute absent providers.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: No provider selected by labels alone; missing runtime, unsupported logic and weaker-than-required evidence block that obligation; no install is performed by this planning task.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Assess logic requirements before availability; inventory exact installed builds; choose finite/SMT/proof routes and minimum strengths by obligation; isolate any later installs; seal budgets and candidate profile policy.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: No provider selected by labels alone; missing runtime, unsupported logic and weaker-than-required evidence block that obligation; no install is performed by this planning task.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
